note: Stage 3, sixth level: flash mental math on borrow subtraction. Two teaching scenes — a bundle of ten plus three sticks with the vertical sum 13 - 9, the bundle breaking and nine sticks flying away, then the finished vertical sum and the call to quick math. Answer phase: ten timed questions in three types (plain equation + three keys / equation card + three balloons / find the wrong sentence), all on a five second bar. No self-answer during the quiz.

lines.text: Look! We have thirteen. We need to take away nine.
We break the ten. Ten minus nine is one.
One plus three is four. Thirteen minus nine equals four.
Remember, when we take away, we can break the ten.
Now, let's try some quick math!
Fifteen minus eight. Quick, tap the right answer!
Thirteen minus nine. Quick, tap the right answer!
Sixteen minus seven. Quick, tap the right answer!
Fourteen minus six. Quick, tap the right answer!
